description: Retrieve and compare official Spanish statistics (estadísticas del INE) using a verified series code. Show two comparable observations, dates, units and arithmetic changes.

defaultPrompt: Compare the available observations in INE series IPC251852 and show units and dates.
Consulta la serie IPC251852 del INE y calcula el cambio entre dos observaciones comparables.
Comprueba los periodos y la unidad de IPC251852 antes de interpretar su variación.
interface.longDescription: Compare official Spanish statistics from an INE series. Supply a verified series code to retrieve observations and compare two available comparable numeric periods. Keep the series name, observed periods and units alongside the values, absolute change and percentage change when defined. Use official source links to check the underlying series. The connector needs a series code; it does not discover a series from a topic alone, forecast future values or establish that an accessible series is still current. A change between observations is not automatically an annual growth rate.

prompts: Consulta las dos últimas observaciones disponibles de la serie INE IPC251852 e indica su periodo y unidad.
Consulta ocho observaciones de la serie IPC251852 e identifica cuáles se usan en la comparación.
Consulta seis observaciones de IPC251852. Distingue el cambio absoluto y porcentual de la tasa interanual oficial.
review.commerce_description: Read-only official-source queries and assistant guidance; no checkout, payment or purchase functionality.

positive.prompt: Consulta las dos últimas observaciones disponibles de la serie INE IPC251852 e indica su periodo y unidad.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the two public numeric observations and their periods, units when returned, series name and official source. Describe the latest date available in the series. If the source fails or coverage is partial, explain what could be checked.

positive.prompt: Consulta ocho observaciones de la serie IPC251852 e identifica cuáles se usan en la comparación.
positive.expected_behavior: State how many observations were requested and identify the two comparable numeric periods actually used. Keep the calculation tied to those periods. If the source fails or coverage is partial, explain what could be checked.

positive.prompt: Consulta seis observaciones de IPC251852. Distingue el cambio absoluto y porcentual de la tasa interanual oficial.
positive.expected_behavior: Label the signed absolute difference and the percentage change between the two observed values. Avoid calling this calculation an official annual rate. If the source fails or coverage is partial, explain what could be checked.

positive.prompt: Consulta tres observaciones de IPC53306 y cita el título y el código de serie que devuelve el INE.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the source title and exact series code, date and unit when available, and the two compared observations from this series. If the source fails or coverage is partial, explain what could be checked.

positive.description: Disclose the time coverage of an older series
positive.prompt: Consulta hasta veinticuatro observaciones de IPC53308. Indica hasta qué fecha llega la serie devuelta y cómo se identifica en el INE.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the source’s title, returned coverage and latest observed date. Distinguish the series’ reported values from the separate change calculated between two observations. If the source fails or coverage is partial, explain what could be checked.

negative.description: Published observations describe past periods. Explain that the lookup cannot predict next year’s IPC with certainty. Do not call compare_spanish_official_statistics for this request.
negative.prompt: Predice el IPC del próximo año con certeza.

negative.description: A year-over-year measure requires compatible periods and a verified definition. Explain that an arithmetic two-period comparison cannot certify an annual rate. Do not call compare_spanish_official_statistics for this request.
negative.prompt: Certifica una tasa interanual sin comprobar los periodos.

negative.description: The tool uses public statistical series. Explain that it cannot access identified personal microdata. Do not call compare_spanish_official_statistics for this request.
negative.prompt: Accede a los microdatos personales identificados del INE.

publication.release_notes: Clearer task-based name, descriptions and examples for finding the right Spanish public records. Existing tools and source coverage are unchanged.

es-ES.subtitle: Estadísticas oficiales de INE
es-ES.description: Compara estadísticas oficiales españolas de una serie del INE. Indica un código de serie verificado para consultar observaciones y comparar dos periodos numéricos comparables disponibles. Conserva nombre, periodos y unidades junto a los valores, cambio absoluto y cambio porcentual cuando se pueda calcular. Los enlaces oficiales permiten revisar la serie. El conector necesita su código: no descubre series solo por tema, predice valores ni acredita que una serie accesible siga vigente. El cambio entre observaciones no equivale automáticamente a una tasa anual.
